title: Chapter 2794 - 118: Corpse Body
content:
Chapter 2794: Chapter 118: Corpse Body

The Bone-slaying Evil God was slain by Mo Hua’s fully executed Taixu God-Slaying Sword, its will dissipating, turning into smoke.

Mo Hua, like a "Taotie" of the Divine Way, swallowed all the smoke into his stomach.

But he did not consume it immediately; he planned to use the robbery thunder on the Taoist Stele for purification, before completely consuming this Evil God.

And with the death of the Bone-slaying Evil God, the nightmare began to collapse.

The surrounding scenery started to distort, and cracks appeared in the dreamland of Evil Thoughts.

An opposing force surged around Mo Hua.

Mo Hua slowly closed his eyes, allowing his divine thought infused body to be "expelled" from the Evil God’s nightmare.

As the world spun around him, when he opened his eyes again, he was still in the bloody Barbarian God Hall.

However, the hall appeared more "real" now, and the overwhelming and terrifying will of the Evil God was nowhere to be felt.

Mo Hua knew he was back in reality.

The purpose of this journey was considered accomplished.

He had killed the Evil God and also consumed the Evil God.

The problem of the Bone-slaying Tribe’s corpse resurrection was also resolved.

The hall was blood-soaked and gloomy, and the aura of famine was still spreading, making it unsuitable for a long stay. Mo Hua decided to leave and rendezvous with Dan Zhu and the others.

But after taking a few steps, he suddenly frowned.

The previous doubts echoed in his mind once again.

After a moment of contemplation, Mo Hua turned back and walked directly to the center of the hall, where the Bone-slaying idol was located.

The idol of the Bone-slaying Tribe was taller and larger, with a human body and demon head, resembling a Barbarian tribal Monster God clad in White Bone Armor, with an imposing presence.

It was a stark contrast to its fallen form, with decayed flesh clinging to white bones.

Mo Hua scrutinized the Bone-slaying idol and then extended his divine sense, searching around.

Moments later, Mo Hua’s divine thought stirred as he indeed found some formation traces beneath the idol.

These formation traces were very obscure, secretly drawn around the idol.

And the style of these formations, Mo Hua recognized.

"This is..."

Divine Tao Formation.

Mo Hua’s gaze deepened.

Someone had... used Divine Tao Formation to imprison the Bone-slaying Barbarian God within this idol.

Forcing it to undergo various pollutants during the great calamity, having no choice but to degenerate passively, ultimately becoming an Evil God...

"Using a Divine Tao Formation to seal a Barbarian God. Then using various pollution methods to corrupt the Barbarian God into an Evil God..."

Mo Hua’s expression grew solemn.

This was clearly a trace of manipulation by human hands.

And these methods were not something an ordinary person could achieve, especially the Divine Tao Formation and the Evil God’s corruption methods, which involved very profound knowledge of the Divine Way.

"Who exactly... is doing this kind of thing?"

Mo Hua first thought of his Uncle but felt it wasn’t quite right.

If Uncle had truly intervened, things would not possibly be in this "mild" state.

Mo Hua frowned deeply, thinking there were still many suspicious aspects involved.

Many conspiracies lay hidden beneath the surface that he couldn’t understand yet.

Mo Hua could only take out a Jade Slip, first copying down these Divine Dao Formation Patterns, and then stood up to leave.

Outside the hall, due to the Evil God’s death, the malevolent will was gradually fading, but the lingering Evil Thoughts were still floating in the air.

Meanwhile, the mist of famine was actually intensifying.

Even the Ultimate Formation of Reconstituted Thick Earth that Mo Hua had previously drawn was being re-corroded by the thickening famine aura.

The "Holy Pattern Road" was somewhat dim.

Some formation patterns even needed to be repaired again.

"I must leave earlier..."

Mo Hua glanced back at the Barbarian God Hall of the Bone-slaying Tribe, then turned and embarked on his journey back.

...

Outside the valley, the atmosphere was extremely tense.

Although they couldn’t see anything from the entire battle, nor did their eyes catch any traces of the duel, and no light or signs of shattering came from the depths of the miasma.

But their divine sense still felt an exceptionally terrifying oppressive force.

As if the world of reality and illusion had blurred.

In the world they couldn’t see, a battle was going on that was moving heaven and earth and making ghosts and gods weep.

And the corpse of the Bone-slaying was becoming extremely frenzied.

Seemingly infected by the Evil God, it was filled with anger, unwillingness, and terror, struggling desperately, with cracks appearing on the heavy Shugu chains that bound it.

The crowd was shocked.

With the Shaman not present, there was no one who could "Zhen" the Bone-slaying with merely a glance.

Once the Bone-slaying was controlled by the Evil Thoughts, escaping the chains, and with its undying body, fought with everyone, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Therefore, everyone had to suppress the Bone-slaying with all their might.

More than twenty Golden Cores took action, using strength and various magic treasures to firmly suppress the Bone-slaying.

Other Barbarian Soldiers formed ranks, vigilantly watching for the Bone-slaying’s loss of control.

The atmosphere became extremely tense, with hearts on edge.

And just as the Bone-slaying’s frenzy reached its peak, seeing that everyone was about to fail in suppressing it.

A more intense divine thought wave suddenly erupted from the depths of the miasma.

It was as if someone had induced an extreme divine thought that could obliterate all the cultivators’ divine senses present.

The true power of this divine thought was something they should not have felt.

But the Evil God’s arrival, the terror in its dying moments, caused the boundaries of reality and illusion to merge for an instant.

The wave of divine thought was transmitted overwhelmingly to reality.

Mo Hua, utilizing his powerful telekinesis, unleashed the "Godslaying Sword" with all his might, allowing the Golden Cores present to feel the fear of a slash that could annihilate even the Divine Soul of an Evil God.

This was a power that made all beings pale in shock.

This was truly the power of a deity.

All present were visibly moved, their heart spirits trembling.

After the single slash, all returned to calm.
